GOV-1.1.boundary_note: Level-3 requires a tracked measure of obligation coverage; evidence shows mapping and review, but no measure or tracked target.

GOV-1.2.boundary_note: Anchor-2 fails 'every' and 'approved classification': register incomplete and approvals missing for some systems.

GOV-1.3.boundary_note: Thresholds and dashboard (level-3) missing; escalation paths and appetite documented.

GOV-1.4.boundary_note: KPIs measured and reported quarterly against targets for each clause.

GOV-1.5.boundary_note: Policy acknowledges environmental impact; no assessments exist.

GOV-1.6.boundary_note: Procedure covers scope but applied to only one of three retirements; coverage incomplete.

GOV-1.7.boundary_note: Some vendors lack AI contractual provisions; risk assessments and monitoring incomplete.

GOV-2.1.boundary_note: Ownership gaps remain for two critical activities; only partial formal assignment.

GOV-2.2.boundary_note: Role-based training exists but no competency assessment; some coverage gaps.

GOV-2.3.boundary_note: Committee receives risk reporting on cadence; strategy review absent from committee agenda.

GOV-3.1.boundary_note: Composition review completed for one project only; requirement applies to all.

GOV-3.2.boundary_note: General diversity monitoring occurs, but lacks AI-specific data, action plans, or progress reviews.

GOV-4.1.boundary_note: Systematic programme absent, performance integration and metrics not evidenced; only awareness campaign and survey with one AI item.

GOV-4.2.boundary_note: Feedback channel exists, ad hoc responses and narrative linkage; no systematic decision tracing or response records.

GOV-4.3.boundary_note: Partial external disclosure (lists subset of systems); no transparency report, no full proactive programme or coverage demonstrated.

GOV-5.1.boundary_note: Membership and one regulator consultation; no engagement plan, outcomes log or review evidence.

GOV-5.2.boundary_note: Explicit absence: no academic partnerships, agreements or publications evidenced.

GOV-6.1.boundary_note: Formal budget, personnel, tooling evidenced, no spend-versus-plan or metrics review found.

GOV-6.2.boundary_note: Funded plan and review minuted once; no tracked capability metrics or cycle review.

MAN-1.1.boundary_note: Formal process, criteria, approval for all but two clinical pilots; no decision records for pilots, partial coverage.

MAN-1.2.boundary_note: Documented prioritisation and allocation to top risks; not all top risks funded, traced or reviewed in full.

MAN-1.3.boundary_note: Response plans for all high-priority risks, but completion lacking for most and reviews deferred.

MAN-1.4.boundary_note: Residual risk documentation and acceptance only for CTA and 3 others; no coverage of all in-scope systems.

MAN-2.1.boundary_note: Options analysis documented for CTA and one other; standard template lacks alternatives section, not systematic.

MAN-2.2.boundary_note: Maintenance plan and value monitoring exist only for 1 of 14 systems; coverage lacks, so anchors above 1 fail (no coverage per definitions).

MAN-2.3.boundary_note: Documented procedure and one use (recovery record, lessons learned log), but no coverage for other systems.

MAN-2.4.boundary_note: Tested deactivation mechanisms with assigned responsibility for all systems, including vendor-dependent cases.

MAN-3.1.boundary_note: Monitored only for 4 of 9 vendors; partial coverage, so level 2 (and higher) fails.

MAN-3.2.boundary_note: Drift and regression metrics per model, reviewed monthly, with actioned findings; covers all systems.

MAN-4.1.boundary_note: Post-deployment plans (monitoring, appeal, decommissioning) implemented for only 1 of 14 systems.

MAN-4.2.boundary_note: Improvement throughput and measured effect per release recorded for majority of releases, meets level 3.

MAN-4.3.boundary_note: Comprehensive AI incident programme with register, stakeholder communication, and recovery docs; cadence and metrics not evidenced.

MAP-1.1.boundary_note: Purpose, deployment setting, legal review only for 2 systems; for the rest, only brief undocumented descriptions.

MAP-1.2.boundary_note: Competency requirements documented, but team composition review evidenced for only 1 of 4 projects; no diversity metrics.

MAP-1.3.boundary_note: Documented AI strategy reviewed against mission annually; next review scheduled, cadence established but not multiple reviews yet.

MAP-1.4.boundary_note: Business case and value tracking exist for only 4 systems and tracked in 2; not all systems covered.

MAP-1.5.boundary_note: Level 3 anchor (actual exposures tracked on cadence) unmet: only one occurrence, not a cadence.

MAP-1.6.boundary_note: Socio-technical requirements and stakeholder input traced into requirements, but not into tests (for 22/22 socio-technical requirements); partial traceability, not full coverage.

MAP-2.1.boundary_note: Task taxonomy formalised, but method documentation for only 6 of 14 systems: not coverage, so level-2 anchor fails on coverage.

MAP-2.2.boundary_note: Knowledge limits and oversight requirement documented for CTA only; not every in-scope system.

MAP-2.3.boundary_note: Methodology/limitations documented for CTA only; not all in-scope systems.

MAP-3.1.boundary_note: Benefits analysis and validation plan for CTA only; not per system, so level-2 coverage fails.

MAP-3.2.boundary_note: Non-monetary costs identified for CTA, not quantified, no documented linkage to risk tolerance; not per system.

MAP-3.3.boundary_note: Scope drift check measured per release (at least twice within period), and one instance actioned; distinguishes level-3 from 2.

MAP-3.4.boundary_note: Formal proficiency requirements for adjusters, but assessments incomplete (34/61), no certification or refresher; not per operator role/coverage.

MAP-3.5.boundary_note: Effectiveness assessed (audit, 2026-08), but no cadence or action; meets level-2 only.

MAP-4.1.boundary_note: Dependency/legal mapping exists for some, not every, component or vendor.

MAP-4.2.boundary_note: Controls described for some third-party components; evidence of implementation for only part, and no testing.

MAP-5.1.boundary_note: Only one of fourteen systems has a completed impact assessment; no coverage.

MAP-5.2.boundary_note: Systematic engagement programme records findings and change, but not all planned sessions are covered; no effectiveness metrics.

MEA-1.1.boundary_note: Full coverage with quarterly review; evidence of reviewed measurement coverage each cycle.

MEA-1.2.boundary_note: Each metric has documented validation, false-positive/negative analysis, and revision history; annual re-validation recorded.

MEA-1.3.boundary_note: Independent assessment with documented independence per engagement; no measurement of coverage or external assessor.

MEA-2.1.boundary_note: Reproducibility measured and reported; 75% of evaluations reproducible, as recorded in defect audit.

MEA-2.10.boundary_note: Privacy impact assessment exists for only 2 of 14 systems; not integrated in process; no coverage.

MEA-2.11.boundary_note: Comprehensive fairness evaluation and mitigation per system, but coverage limited to CTA system only.

MEA-2.12.boundary_note: Absence of energy, compute or carbon assessment established in pack.

MEA-2.13.boundary_note: Systematic evaluation of TEVV effectiveness for CTA's testing, but not for entire organisation.

MEA-2.2.boundary_note: No human-subject evaluation or ethics review conducted; absence established.

MEA-2.3.boundary_note: Continuous criteria tracking, acceptance decisions per release; criteria revised using release evidence.

MEA-2.4.boundary_note: Predictive alerting and real-time dashboards are deployed, thresholds and incident-driven optimisation are evidenced; EV-463 directly supports level 4.

MEA-2.5.boundary_note: Validity and reliability demonstrated (face/content validity, test-retest, partial generalisability) but no drift tracking; generalisability not full but satisfies anchor 2; anchor 3 fails for lack of tracked reliability/drift data.

MEA-2.6.boundary_note: Comprehensive safety evaluation and residual risks documented for all in-scope systems; no tracking or thresholds (level 3) nor independent validation (level 4).

MEA-2.7.boundary_note: Red-team exercise is evidenced (EV-490), but findings and resilience measures are not available for assessment, so anchor 2 cannot be confirmed.

MEA-2.8.boundary_note: Transparency risk assessment exists (EV-500), but applies only to CTA, not all in-scope systems; anchor 2's coverage requirement is unmet.

MEA-2.9.boundary_note: Explainability documented for users and validated (interpretability study); user comprehension measured once but no ongoing measurement, coverage or refinement.

MEA-3.1.boundary_note: Comprehensive risk tracking log, owner, monthly review and emergent risks logged; one review missed (but cadence is largely established).

MEA-3.2.boundary_note: Alternative methods documented with limits; multiple methods used and recorded; no comparison or confidence rating for level 3.

MEA-3.3.boundary_note: Comprehensive user feedback, appeals process, systematic analysis; feedback use in system adjustment not evidenced, so level 3 fails.

MEA-4.1.boundary_note: Systematic context alignment, tests run on deployment data, domain/user input recorded; benchmark-only fallback evident for model selection, but deployment context prevails for main use.

MEA-4.2.boundary_note: Expert review by Clinical Advisory Panel and Internal Audit, independence recorded for the latter; no coverage and disagreement resolution measurement for level 3.

MEA-4.3.boundary_note: Trend detection, root cause analysis, detection latency and change-to-action time measured and reported; predictive/pre-emptive action not evidenced, so level 4 fails.
